description: Get prices for a EUROPEAN / cross-Channel transfer from London/UK to a continental destination (e.g. Ghent, Bruges, Paris, Brussels, Amsterdam, Cologne, Milan, Barcelona). Use this — NOT london_airport_transfer_quote — whenever the destination is OUTSIDE the UK / on the European continent. Returns per-car-type prices, fixed per vehicle, including the Eurotunnel crossing. Prices are FINAL — quote them exactly, no discounts. If the city is not configured the tool returns the list of available EU destinations; in that case tell the customer the team will confirm a price for it.

car_type.description: Optional single EU car type (Standard, Electric, People Carrier, Executive, Large PPL, Executive PPL, Minibus, Luxury). Omit for all car types.

hub_code.description: Nearest UK departure hub for the UK leg: LHR, LGW, STN, LTN, LCY, SOU. For a London pickup use LHR.

name: eu_transfer_quote
title: Get European Transfer Quote
